derivation.atFrames: stored frames[].world / frames[].landmarks at this clip's frame times (nearest frame to each instant)
derivation.continuous: kinematic model rebuilt from scenario job "sample-checkin", sampled every 0.5 ms with exact event instants

conventions.frontShoulder: tossing side (left for a right-hander); hitting shoulder = the other
conventions.hipMid: midpoint of the LEFT_HIP and RIGHT_HIP landmarks (hip joint centres); heights are court z
conventions.trophy: kinematic trophy position = truth.json events.trophy (midpoint of the hold); hipLowest = lowest mid-hip in [tossRelease, contact - 0.08 s], the METRICS.md 2.4.4 trophy detector and the leg-drive lowest point
conventions.deg2D: image-plane angle in this clip's camera (pixels, isotropic)
conventions.deg2DLevel: the same camera rotated level about its centre (pitch and roll removed; METRICS.md 1.1 level correction)
conventions.deg3D: elevation above the horizontal plane (court z up)
